fhem_import.title: Import from FHEM
fhem_import.description:
Paste the settings from FHEM. To get them:

1. In FHEM, enter in the command line at the top: `list -r TYPE=AutoShuttersControl` and then `list -r ASC=[12]`
2. Select the output of both commands, copy it and paste it here.

The whole fhem.cfg works as well. Only define and attr lines are read, nothing is sent anywhere. A single shutter is easier to take over at the cover itself: open the cover → *Import from FHEM*.
